# Textarea

A text area enables users to input and edit multiple lines of text, providing a larger space than a regular text input field, making it suitable for longer text entries such as comments, descriptions, or messages.

**Stylesheet:** `components/textarea/textarea.css`

Layout wrappers named `showcase-*` belong to the documentation page, not to the component: leave them out.

## 

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | `string` | — | Label text displayed above the textarea. |
| `placeholder` | `string` | — | Placeholder text shown when the field is empty. |
| `variant` | `'default' \| 'lighter' \| 'darker'` | `'default'` | Visual style variant controlling background color. |
| `value` | `string` | `''` | Current value of the textarea. |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Prevents user interaction. |
| `readonly` | `boolean` | `false` | Makes the content non-editable but copyable. |
| `error` | `boolean` | `false` | Applies error styling (red border). |
| `required` | `boolean` | `false` | Marks the field as required (asterisk on label). |
| `resize` | `boolean` | `true` | Enables vertical resizing of the textarea. |
| `rows` | `number` | `4` | Number of visible text lines. |
| `cols` | `number` | `50` | Visible width of the textarea in character widths. |
| `helper-text` | `string` | — | Descriptive hint text displayed below the field. |

## States

All interactive states of the textarea component — default, filled, disabled, read-only, and focus (click to see).

```html
<div class="textarea" style="max-width: 280px;">
    <label class="textarea__label">Default</label>
    <textarea class="textarea__field" placeholder="Placeholder text" rows="3"></textarea>
</div>

<div class="textarea" style="max-width: 280px;">
    <label class="textarea__label">Filled</label>
    <textarea class="textarea__field" rows="3">Entered text content that the user has typed into the field.</textarea>
</div>

<div class="textarea textarea--disabled" style="max-width: 280px;">
    <label class="textarea__label">Disabled</label>
    <textarea class="textarea__field" placeholder="Placeholder text" rows="3" disabled=""></textarea>
</div>



<div class="textarea textarea--disabled" style="max-width: 280px;">
    <label class="textarea__label">Disabled filled</label>
    <textarea class="textarea__field" rows="3" disabled="">Entered text</textarea>
</div>

<div class="textarea" style="max-width: 280px;">
    <label class="textarea__label">Read-only</label>
    <textarea class="textarea__field" rows="3" readonly="">Read-only content that cannot be edited.</textarea>
</div>
```

## Error State

Error styling with helper text for validation feedback.

```html
<div class="textarea" style="max-width: 320px;">
    <label class="textarea__label textarea__label--required">Description</label>
    <textarea class="textarea__field textarea__field--error" rows="3">Invalid value</textarea>
    <span class="textarea__helper textarea__helper--error">
        <svg class="textarea__helper-icon" viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="none" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
            <path d="M8 5.333V8m0 2.667h.007M14.667 8A6.667 6.667 0 1 1 1.333 8a6.667 6.667 0 0 1 13.334 0Z" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.333" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"></path>
        </svg>
        This field is required. Please enter a description.
    </span>
</div>

<div class="textarea" style="max-width: 320px;">
    <label class="textarea__label textarea__label--required">Comments</label>
    <textarea class="textarea__field textarea__field--error" placeholder="Enter your comments" rows="3"></textarea>
    <span class="textarea__helper textarea__helper--error">
        <svg class="textarea__helper-icon" viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="none" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
            <path d="M8 5.333V8m0 2.667h.007M14.667 8A6.667 6.667 0 1 1 1.333 8a6.667 6.667 0 0 1 13.334 0Z" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.333" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"></path>
        </svg>
        Please provide your comments.
    </span>
</div>
```

## RTL Layout

Right-to-left support for Arabic and other RTL languages.

```html
<div class="textarea" style="max-width: 320px;">
    <label class="textarea__label textarea__label--required">الوصف</label>
    <textarea class="textarea__field" rows="3">نص تم إدخاله في حقل النص المتعدد الأسطر</textarea>
    <span class="textarea__helper">يرجى إدخال وصف مفصل.</span>
</div>
<div class="textarea" style="max-width: 320px;">
    <label class="textarea__label textarea__label--required">التعليقات</label>
    <textarea class="textarea__field textarea__field--error" rows="3"></textarea>
    <span class="textarea__helper textarea__helper--error">
        <svg class="textarea__helper-icon" viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="none" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
            <path d="M8 5.333V8m0 2.667h.007M14.667 8A6.667 6.667 0 1 1 1.333 8a6.667 6.667 0 0 1 13.334 0Z" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.333" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"></path>
        </svg>
        يرجى إدخال تعليقاتك.
    </span>
</div>
```

## With Helper Text

Helper text provides additional context or instructions below the textarea.

```html
<div class="textarea" style="max-width: 320px;">
    <label class="textarea__label">Bio</label>
    <textarea class="textarea__field" placeholder="Tell us about yourself..." rows="3"></textarea>
    <span class="textarea__helper">
        <svg class="textarea__helper-icon" viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="none" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
            <path d="M8 7.333V10.667M8 5.333h.007M14.667 8A6.667 6.667 0 1 1 1.333 8a6.667 6.667 0 0 1 13.334 0Z" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.333" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"></path>
        </svg>
        Write a short description about yourself.
    </span>
</div>
<div class="textarea" style="max-width: 320px;">
    <label class="textarea__label textarea__label--required">Feedback</label>
    <textarea class="textarea__field" placeholder="Share your feedback..." rows="3"></textarea>
    <span class="textarea__helper">Maximum 500 characters.</span>
</div>
```
